Veterans Benefits: Military retirement pay 100% exempt from PA state income tax. 100% disabled veterans receive full property tax exemption. PA operates 6 state veterans homes including Gino J. Merli Veterans' Center in Scranton.
Description: Situated in northeastern Pennsylvania at the edge of the Pocono Mountains, Scranton offers an affordable cost of living roughly two hours from both New York City and Philadelphia. The city serves as a regional healthcare hub with convenient access to the nearby Wilkes-Barre VA Medical Center. Retirees benefit from Pennsylvania's exemption of military retirement pay from state income tax alongside mountain recreation, skiing at Montage Mountain, and historic cultural sites like Steamtown National Historic Site.
